Theorem
[Hamilton in dimension four (Theorem 35.36)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0325 1. ch35:35.36\group Alternative Stability Methods

If a closed simply-connected $4$-manifold has positive curvature operator, its volume-normalized Ricci flow converges to a unique constant-positive-curvature metric; the manifold is the standard sphere (or projective space if nonorientable).
